name: devchar-delay
description: 3.3 V CMOS delay-stage characterization -- unstarved + current-starved rings, fan-out-1 chain, device drive
claim: #4 -> #8 (design-input, not a spec line) -- per-PVT-corner delay-cell drive/delay and current-starved-ring frequency vs. starving current, sufficient to bound ring-VCO frequency spread worst-slow to worst-fast and to estimate Kvco.
methodology: Measurement topology: five sub-circuits share one deck (see testbench/tb_delay_stage.spice header comment), rendered as one sub-table each via this manifest's topology_groups -- (1) R1/R4: unstarved 5-stage self-loaded CMOS ring at 1x and 4x sizing, stage delay td = T/(2N) from 8 periods after start-up (the frequency ceiling a current-starved ring approaches as fully-on); (2) CS-lo/md/hi: three 5-stage current-starved rings (the DR-001 Decision-2 delay cell: matched PMOS-head/NMOS-tail starving devices, L_st=0.5um), each starved at a fixed *ideal* mirrored current (10/50/250 uA) so the bias-generator's own PVT sensitivity is isolated from the cell's; frequency measured over 4 periods after start-up; (3) CH: open fan-out-1 inverter chain (ideal step in) giving tpHL/tpLH separately and 10-90% transition times; (4) DC: single 1x NMOS/PMOS at Vgs=Vds=Vdd for peak drive current.

Simulator settings: `tran 5p 150n uic` (5 ps max step; 150 ns covers >=6 periods of the slowest starved ring at the slowest corner). The .ic cards in the fragment set each ring's start-up state and the fan-out-1 chain's DC-correct state, so the edge indices in the ch_* measurements count only real switching events.

Limitation: the CS bias uses an *ideal* current source into a diode mirror, not the real band-select/V-to-I bias network #8 will design -- this isolates the delay cell's PVT sensitivity from the bias generator's, which is the correct scope for this record but means the real bias network's own PVT sensitivity is a separate, later characterization.

Limitation: no passive corner axis. The DUT contains no MIM/MOS caps and no poly resistors, so the five MOS bundles (which hold every passive family at *_typical) are the complete process axis for this claim.
Statistical switches: sw_stat_global = sw_stat_mismatch = 0 (nominal device skew from the corner section only, no Monte Carlo mismatch).

Derived quantities the pre-migration runner computed in awk (ring1x supply charge per stage transition q = |I_avg|*T/N and the equivalent switched capacitance C = q/Vdd) are NOT re-derived here: r1_period and r1_iavg are recorded per corner, and q/C follow from them by arithmetic. Recording the two measured quantities rather than two arithmetic restatements of them is the harness convention.

ch_tphl.expr: trig v(c2) val='vsup/2' td=2n rise=1 targ v(c3) val='vsup/2' td=2n fall=1

ch_tplh.expr: trig v(c2) val='vsup/2' td=12n fall=1 targ v(c3) val='vsup/2' td=12n rise=1

ch_tf.expr: trig v(c3) val='0.9*vsup' td=2n fall=1 targ v(c3) val='0.1*vsup' td=2n fall=1

ch_tr.expr: trig v(c3) val='0.1*vsup' td=12n rise=1 targ v(c3) val='0.9*vsup' td=12n rise=1

ring1x.description: unstarved 5-stage self-loaded ring, 1x sizing (Wn=1.0um Wp=2.5um L=0.28um) -- the frequency ceiling of the cell

ring4x.description: identical unstarved 5-stage ring at 4x sizing (Wn=4.0um Wp=10.0um) -- separates self-loading from fixed parasitics

cs_lo.description: 5-stage current-starved ring (DR-001 Decision 2 cell) starved at an ideal 10 uA

cs_md.description: same current-starved ring starved at an ideal 50 uA

cs_hi.description: same current-starved ring starved at an ideal 250 uA -- with cs_lo, the 25x-current Kvco proxy

fo1_chain.description: open 4-inverter chain (1x), stage 3 measured with an identical driver and a fan-out-1 load

device_drive.description: single 1x NMOS (W=1.0um) and PMOS (W=2.5um) at Vgs=Vds=Vdd -- peak output-stage drive current
